content: Pɔl kan'beenà Yɛlusàlɛm
Yàmɛnà naa ungö mukaabà anà ba a mpay anà muwal an'swà, bi kàkyen ipey tii u Kɔs, taaŋtyà bi kàkɔlà Rɔdɛ, apan bi kàkyà Patara.
Paa, bi kàmɛn an'swà màmukyà Fɛnɛsi, laa kàbilà bi, kàkyen bi.
Mpal kàtääl bi isaŋ a Shipɛlɛ, bi kàsàwɛy kya u kɔɔ a ikaar, waa kàwɛl mbwo mukyà mper a Siri, bi kàtɔlà u Tir, ikal màtwey an'swà buur ama.
Akun bi kàmɛn alɔŋki, bi kàbwaay paa mpɔsà mwɛy. U mbwo a Dweelà ba bàtɛn a Pɔl naa nde ukɔɔn abeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Wɛɛ mpal byàkwe ilä abi, bi kàfàwal mbwo mukyà. Ba banswà anà akyay aba anà baan aba bàkiswà tii u nsà a bul. Mpal kàtöl bi kà un'kɔɔl a an'dà, bi kàbü an'köm, waa kàyamà.
Ungö mupɛɛl mbɔr a ntsüü anà atɔŋ, bi kàbilà kà an'swà, wɛɛ ba bàfurà ndwà aba.
Wɛɛ akà bi, bi kàmay mbwo abi yanswà sɛmà Tir tii Petɔlɛmayis, bi kàpɛ atɔŋ mbɔr, waa kàbwaay apà ba ilä mwɛy.
Taaŋtyà, kàtoo bi, bi kàkyen Sɛzarɛ. Akun, bi kàbilà u ndwà a Filipo un'paylàsaŋ a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, umwɛy uboo a Nsambwaar, waa bi kàbwaay paa.
Nde kàkäl abà baan akaar ankɔr anà. Ba bàfataa ngɔɔm.
Bi kàkäl paa ilä mbɔɔn, umpal kàyi ŋangɔɔm mwɛy kàfü Yuday ikɔb ande Agabüs.

Nde kayi akà bi anà kàwɛl un'di a lɔŋ a Pɔl, nde kàbäm wa kà in'kɔl anà kà an'kɔɔ ande ŋakwo, waa kàtɛn naa: « Làwem, Dweelà In'kyɛɛl an'tɛn naa mbuur aŋun'di wà, Ayudà bàsàkyer un'bäm u Yɛlusàlɛm asànaa an'bäm mɛ là, waa bàsun'yälà kà an'kɔɔ a angyey. »
Mpal bàwem bi indiir abi, bi ŋakwo anà atɔŋ a bul alan, bi bàbɔ̈ɔ̈n Pɔl mukɔɔn abeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Apan, Pɔl kàfuur naa: « Undiir nà làlelà bɛ anà làkaamà bɛ mpem amɛ? Wɛɛ akà mɛ, mɛ an'kyey, kà nà mukan'bäm in'siŋ mpɛl anki, wɛɛ anà mukwà u Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn ikɔb a Mwol Yɛsu. »
Bi bàsàkwo anki musɔɔm an'kyän ande, bi bàkäl akul, waa bàtɛn naa: « Wɛy ukwen a Mwol bàkäl. »
Ungö a ndam a ilä, bi bàlɔ̈ɔ̈n indiir abi, waa kàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Ndam a alɔŋki uboo alɔŋki a Sɛzarɛ bàkiswà anà bisyeen mukàbɔ̈ɔ̈n u ndwà a un'nsi Shipɛle mwɛy ikɔb ande Mnasɔn. Nde kàkäl un'lɔŋki fà itaan.
Pɔl kan'kàler Zyak
U ntööl abi u Yɛlusàlɛm, atɔŋ biwɛl unsà un'sak wanswà.
Taaŋtyà, Pɔl kàkyen anà bi u ndwà a Zyak, ikal bàköŋ andweer banswà.
Ungö kapɛ nde mbɔr, nde kakyään pànsi pànsi indiir byanswà kàkyer Nzam akà baar mpa abà Ayudà u mbwo a isal ande.
Ungö mukun'wem, ba bàsi Nzam làkoo, waa bàfuur akà Pɔl naa: « Un'tɔŋ, ngye akimanà, Ayudà nsaab kwe ban'sà làkwikilà, ba banswà ban'pà mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba unsà un'kɔɔn.

Wɛɛ ntɔn ngye, ba bàwem in'ŋün naa ngye ayilɔŋ ndaa a nkɔɔl, naa Ayudà bàfàkal uboo a baar mpa abà Ayudà bàtön Mɔsɛ, anà mukakyään naa ba bàkɔɔn akyɛy baan aba anà bàkɔɔn alab nkääl a Ayudà.
Bi waa ikyer aben? Itàkal kaben, ba bàkyer ayàyöb naa ngye an'yà.
Undiiràwun, ngye akyer asànaa kaswaŋ bi: bi ibye abà abaal anà bàkyàdyà kyän.

Asyen, kadi nkwà anà ba. Fur sye ngim aba ntɔn ba bàkɔɔl ntswe aba. Abun baar banswà bàyàyöb ba naa ndaa yanswà bàwem ba ntɔn ngye kàyà ndandaa anki, wɛɛ ngye, ngye ŋakwo sye afàlab Un'kɔɔn.

Akà baar mpa abà Ayudà bàbulà aŋàlàkwikilà, bi, bi kàkyasöön mbar kàtsül bi: ukɔɔn adyà in'twaŋ ifàfà unsà ibɔɔn bàfàpà akà itɛk, anà an'kil, anà in'twaŋ mpa bàtsül kil, anà ukɔɔn akyer ipasasɛ. »
Apan, Pɔl kàsyen baar abà, waa kàdi nkwà anà ba taaŋtyà. Nde kàbilà u ndwà a Nzam ntɔn mukyään ilä isàwà nkwà anà bàsàpà ibɔɔn ntɔn umwɛy umwɛy uboo a ba.
Nköör a Pɔl u ndwà a Nzam.
Wɛɛ ilä nsambwaar byàkäl tsütsü mukwo mpal bun'mɛn Ayudà a Azi u ndwà a Nzam. Apan ba bàsi lingyoomà uboo a un'sɛŋ a baar wanswà, waa bun'kör,

bàkuub in'kwɛŋ, waa bàtɛn naa: « Baar a Isàlɛl, kàlayää libay! Le mbuur akwà ayinwan anà un'sɛŋ anà un'kɔɔn abi, anà ikal ki unsà ndaa uyilɔŋ nde mper yanswà anà akà baar banswà! Nde sye kàkyàbiil Angɛlɛki uboo a ndwà a Nzam ntɔn mubɛy ikal in'kyɛɛl ki! »
Ntɔn ba bàtwab atàman Trɔfimɛ un'nsi Ԑfɛsɔ anà nde uboo a bul, lalan bàsii ba naa Pɔl kun'biil u ndwà a Nzam.
Bul lanswà waa làni, un'sɛŋ waa kàyàköŋ. Baar bàkör Pɔl, waa bun'twey u ndwà a Nzam, apan ba bàdübà ibeenà agyägyä.
Ba bàleŋà mbwo mukun'dwa, mpal làkàtöl làsaŋ akà mfum a aŋità nsaab a Lɔmà naa Yɛlusàlɛm lanswà lan'bilà u lingyoomà.
Taaŋ nsil alan, nde kàwɛl aŋità anà an'kaptɛn, waa kàkyà ntiin mupay un'sɛŋ u mper bàkäl ba. Mpal bàmɛn ba mfum a aŋità nsaab anà aŋità, ba bàwɛy mudüb Pɔl.
Apan mfum a aŋità kàsin tsütsü apà nde, waa kun'kör, kàswɛŋ mukun'bäm an'dwaaŋ. Ungö apan, nde kàkwen muyöb naa nde wà nà anà nde sye ininà kan'kyer.

Wɛɛ, uboo a un'sɛŋ a baar, baar baar bàkäl mukuub in'kwɛŋ. Unsà isak isak aki, mfum a aŋità kàsàyöb anki akà undiir mwɛy. Undiir awun, kàswɛŋ nde naa Pɔl bun'syen u Fɔrtɛrɛs a aŋità a Lɔmà.
Mpal kàkɔlà nde udu a ikaar, aŋità bàkyer un'syɛn ntɔn nkyɛl a un'sɛŋ a baar yàkäl mbɔɔn,
ntɔn un'kàbɔ a baar kàkäl muyun'lab anà musà in'kwɛŋ naa: « Ukü! »
Pɔl kan'sà un'lɔɔn ande
U taaŋ bàlun'biil ba u Fɔrtɛrɛs, Pɔl kàtɛn a mfum a nsaab naa: « Nkye mbwo ikyàkal mɛ mutɛn undiir mwɛy a ngye? » Mfum a aŋità kun'fuul naa: « Nkye ngye akyàyöb Ingɛlɛki?
Nkye ngye, kà ngye anki awà un'ngipiti awà kàtwääl ipaay mfwen anà kàsyen adwää baar nsaab nà u nsye a ipɔl? »
Pɔl kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ? Mɛ in'wà un'yudà, bul a mɛ Tarsisi u Silisi, bul làmwɛy là làkoo. Mɛ amabɔɔn, mpɛ mbwo muyääm a un'sɛŋ. »
Mfum a nsaab waa kun'pɛ mbwo. Pɔl kàkäl umbäär udu a ikaar, kàkyer isii a kɔɔ, un'sɛŋ a baar wanswà waa kàkäl a duu. Apan nde kàkyään ba unsà Ɛbɛlyɔ, waa kàtɛn naa:
